title: “Ultrasound-Assisted High-Fluidics Phacoaspiration”: An Efficient and Safe Technique for Nucleus Quadrant Workup Through 2.2 mm Mini- and 1.6 mm Micro-Incisions Following Manual or Femtosecond Laser Sectorial Lens Fragmentation

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license', link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Bilateral age-related cataract (LOCS III nuclear hardness, medians 2-3), immediate sequential bilateral cataract surgery; prior intraocular surgery, glaucoma, inflammatory eye disease, any corneal disease and severe retinal pathology excluded

groups.description: eT2.2 HF: high-fluidics coaxial phaco (Oertli OS3, peristaltic, bottle 100 cm, conquer flow 45 mL/min, vacuum 500 mmHg) with the easyTip 2.2 slim-shaft-strong-bevel needle through a 2.2 mm posterolimbal incision, manual direct-crack divide and conquer, methylcellulose OVD, intracameral cefuroxime; prednisolone and ketorolac 3x/day for 3 weeks; one randomized eye per patient, one surgeon (NCT01936727)

eT1.6 iaCOMICS HF: high-fluidics infusion-assisted coaxial phaco with the easyTip COMICS micro-needle through a 1.6 mm incision plus sideport infusion handpiece (flow 50 mL/min, vacuum 600 mmHg), biaxial cortex aspiration; same surgeon, technique and aftercare; the operated fellow eye

exclusions.what: jcm-14-05887-t003 ECC and ECL rows; Tables 1, 2 and 4 (machine settings, operative medians, comparisons)
Comparison groups CMP 2.8 mm low-fluidics and eT2.2 enhanced-fluidics (Table 4, Figures 3-5)
exclusions.reason: Historical groups from earlier publications without CCT values in this article

notes: Prospective randomized intraindividual comparison with immediate sequential bilateral surgery: both eyes of each patient were operated, so the fellow eye is an operated arm, not an unoperated control, and the arms are not independent samples.

Role: both arms are variants of the article's high-fluidics technique compared with each other and neither is declared experimental relative to the other; both recorded as control (consistent with the endothelium-dataset extraction of the same article).

Series n: 77 patients were randomized and 50 completed the 6-month follow-up; Table 3 does not state whether the preop, day-1 and 1-week means include all 77 or only the 50 completers, so n is set to the 50 completers.
Method 'unstated': Methods say CCT was measured preoperatively and at each visit but do not name the device.
Statistics: data are means ± SD if normally distributed, otherwise medians [min; max]; the CCT cells are reported as mean ± SD.

series.baseline_label: Preoperative CCT measured 1 week before surgery (Table 3 'Central Corneal Thickness (CCT)' row 'preop', column 'eT2.2 HF')
